describe.description: Model summary, source files with sha256, thresholds, budget. No arguments.

time_to_critical.description: Simulate cabin CO2 from a start state at one scrubber flow, or during a stop. Returns minutes to ELEVATED, minutes to CRITICAL, peak ppm, final state. Call before changing the scrubber.

properties.stopMinutes: number, minutes, stop from minute 0 (default 0 = no stop)
properties.resumePercent: number, 0 to 100, command after the stop (default 100)

sweep.description: Operating map: simulate one run per flow in a list. Returns per flow: peak ppm, final state, minutes to ELEVATED and CRITICAL, steady state ppm, energy Wh. Use to pick the lowest safe flow.

properties.flowPercents: array of 1 to 20 numbers, 0 to 100, percent
